findings.title: Consumer child pool cleanup can replace the primary fixture failure

locations.detail: attempt() rejection is replaced by a rejecting db.end() in finally.
Child fixture/CAS/assertion rejection is replaced by pool.end() rejection.
runChild catches/rethrows primary, but rejecting pool.end() in finally replaces it.

repro.method: Parse actual candidate and before-image TypeScript with pinned TypeScript. Extract only the exact finalizer block. Evaluate a finite synthetic try { throw primary } with that finalizer, supplying db/pool stubs whose end() throws a distinct secondary Error. Application/runtime/PG bodies are never imported or executed.
repro.observed: All three candidate closures reject with secondary only; no AggregateError/cause retains primary. Before-images reproduce the same behavior.
repro.expected: On body plus pool cleanup failure, retain primary and distinct cleanup failure together (primary as cause), without converting any failure to success; a single primary or single cleanup failure must still fail.

findings.impact: A child may still exit nonzero, but its thrown failure and the parent transcript no longer retain the original assertion/PG/NUL/journal failure as the primary cause. Parent cleanup helpers only see the child outcome and cannot reconstruct the discarded error object. Existing error.json/trace files, where successfully written, can offer diagnostic context but do not make the thrown primary-plus-secondary contract true.
findings.provenance: Pre-existing behavior retained by the candidate, not an introduced regression. It is within the registered three consumer files and prevents satisfying the explicit required TH06 preservation target. No broader runtime/product change is requested.
findings.requestedChange: Preserve body and pool-cleanup errors in these consumer child closures with the same primary/cause/aggregate behavior as the new cleanup helper, preserving original assertions/payloads/selection. Add finite mocked consumer-boundary controls for body-only, cleanup-only, both-error and success cases. Do not execute PG/application bodies to verify this repair.
